hints.title: Single Pass Index Tracking
hints.text: Maintain the most recent index seen for each of the two target words while scanning through the list from left to right.

hints.title: Running Distance Minimization
hints.text: Whenever either target word is encountered, update its index and compute the distance to the most recent index of the other target word.

hints.title: Absolute Difference Greedy Update
hints.text: Initialize pointers to negative one and minimum distance to infinity. For each word matching word1 or word2, record the position and take the minimum of the running minimum and the absolute index difference.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N * L) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Collecting all occurrences and comparing every pair takes quadratic O(N^2 * L) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking the latest occurrence of each word guarantees checking adjacent pairs in a single linear pass with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that the closest occurrences must be consecutive encounters in the list.
